issues.legal_issue: Whether a home buyer agreement’s forfeiture clause allowing a developer to retain 20% of the basic sale price is enforceable when the agreement is one-sided and unfair to the consumer.
Whether forfeiture of 10% of the basic sale price is a reasonable amount of earnest money to retain when a buyer cancels an apartment allotment.
Whether the buyer is entitled to interest on the refunded amount after cancelling the allotment because of falling property prices.
